description: Unified locale-aware resolver + menu-kind render refactor + full-shell behaviour test. Adds resolve_locale_verb(V) applying the Req 11.6 order and calls it at BOTH the command-line front door and the menu-selection entry, returning the ROOT command dispatched through the UNCHANGED front door (Task 11.4). Splits the over-400-line menu render.rs (pure refactor) then changes the command column to render the active-locale alias surface via a new i18n_keys helper (Task 11.5). Adds the full-shell egui_kittest behaviour test and proves the en behaviour-neutral baseline while keeping the menu first-Tab focus test green (Task 11.6). Depends on FEAT-001 (the locale alias store + entry model). ASCII-only; TDD; agent COMPILE-ONLY scoped verification.
steps: Read docs/specs/localization/task-crnr109-locale-alias/context.json and FEAT-001.json findings FIRST. Confirm FEAT-001's LocaleAliasStore + keyed AliasTable are present.

Task 11.4 -- add a NEW module crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/locale_resolver.rs (register it) with resolve_locale_verb(&self, verb, env_name) -> LocaleResolveOutcome { Root(String), Unknown(String) } applying EXACTLY: (1) look up verb (uppercased) in the store's AliasTable for env_name via canonical_verb -> Root(canonical); (2) else if verb is a root command (registry/is_root_command) -> Root(verb); (3) else Unknown(verb). The store table already carries the active locale overlay + synthesised identity rows so a localised surface and a bare English root both resolve. The resolver only REWRITES the verb token to its root; it never dispatches.

Task 11.4 -- call the resolver at the command-line entry: in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dispatch.rs::dispatch_command_string, AFTER the '=' strip and BEFORE the prelude/resolve_target, split raw into verb+arg (shell::helpers::split_verb_arg), run resolve_locale_verb(verb, active_env_name); if the root differs from the entered surface, reassemble root+arg and continue the UNCHANGED prelude/resolve_target/ladder path with the root; on Unknown, let the existing not-found path run. Behaviour-neutral at en (verb==root). Also route the menu-selection entry through the same resolver: in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_menu.rs::activate_menu_option feed the option's ROOT command through resolve_locale_verb (root in -> same root out) for the single-path property, then dispatch as today. The ROOT is what history/session/macro record (Req 11.9, 10.3).

Task 11.4 tests FIRST (locale_resolver.rs #[cfg(test)]): resolve_locale_verb_follows_the_req_11_6_order with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.6 (table-driven: localised surface SOEK->Root(FIND) [1.1]; bare root FIND->Root(FIND) [1.2.1]; unknown ZZZ->Unknown [1.2.2]); root_command_is_returned_regardless_of_surface with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.9, 10.3 (SOEK and FIND both return Root FIND). Build the store with an af overlay SOEK->FIND for the env under test.

Task 11.5 SPLIT FIRST (pure refactor, no behaviour change, no gate): menu_workspace/render.rs is ~485 non-test lines (OVER 400). Move the pure helpers (MenuColours, CALENDAR_* consts, command_column_width, format_option_row, option_font, option_prefix_job, option_prefix_text, natural_width_from_rows, natural_option_list_width) and their unit tests into a new crates/ff-desktop/src/menu_workspace/render_layout.rs; keep render_menu_workspace, MenuRenderResult, and the frame loop in render.rs. Register the module in menu_workspace/mod.rs and fix imports. Confirm BOTH files are under 400 non-test lines and the moved tests pass BEFORE adding behaviour.

Task 11.5 -- add i18n_keys::localised_option_command(environment, option, display_surface_source) mirroring localised_option_description: return the alias surface for the option's ROOT command in the active locale (via the store's FFCMD AliasTable display_surface_for(root)), falling back to the root command string when no localised alias exists (Req 11.7, 11.8). Compute the per-option display surfaces shell-side in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/render_body_arms.rs (where &self is available) and pass them into render_menu_workspace so the renderer stays free of shell coupling; the command column renders the display surface instead of option.command. Selecting an option STILL yields MenuOption with the ROOT command (unchanged persistence), fed through the 11.4 resolver.

Task 11.5 test FIRST (i18n_keys.rs #[cfg(test)]): localised_option_command_resolves_alias_surface_else_root with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.7, 11.8 -- with a store carrying SOEK->FIND (key verb-find) for FFCMD and a test catalogue defining verb-find=SOEK, assert the helper returns 'SOEK' for a FIND option and the raw root (e.g. 'CATALOGS') when no alias/key exists.

Task 11.6 tests FIRST (full-shell egui_kittest, crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_command.rs or a new tests_locale_menu.rs under the shell test tree, using harness_shell()/build_eframe): full_shell_menu_option_shows_localised_surface_and_dispatches_root with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.7, 11.9 (install a non-en test catalogue + alias store overlay af SOEK->FIND on a menu carrying a FIND option; assert the command column shows SOEK, then activate it and assert the recorded command/history entry is the ROOT FIND); full_shell_menu_option_en_shows_root_verb_unchanged with // Validates: localization Requirement 10.2 (en/no overlay -> column shows the root verb, dispatch unchanged). Keep the existing menu-kind first-Tab focus egui_kittest test GREEN (do not touch the focus latch) and re-run it.
Add any test-only catalogue/store setup helpers to crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_common.rs (extend install_catalogue_for_tests). No production change beyond Tasks 11.4/11.5.

Record in findings: the exact resolver module/function names, the render.rs split file names, the i18n_keys helper signature, and the full-shell test names, so FEAT-003 and the convergence step can reference them.
acceptance_criteria: resolve_locale_verb applies the Req 11.6 order (alias-for-L -> root; else root-table hit; else Unknown) and ALWAYS returns the ROOT; it is called at dispatch_command_string (command line) and activate_menu_option (menu selection) as the single path.
menu_workspace/render.rs is split so both render.rs and render_layout.rs are under 400 non-test lines; the moved layout tests pass; no behaviour change from the split.
The menu command column renders the active-locale alias surface via localised_option_command, falling back to the root when no alias/key exists; selection still carries the ROOT command.
The full-shell tests pass: a non-en menu option shows the localised surface and dispatches/records the ROOT; the en case shows the root verb unchanged (behaviour-neutral, Req 10.2).
The existing menu-kind first-Tab focus egui_kittest test still passes (focus contract unchanged).
No second dispatcher / nav stack / persistence format / per-Context focus mechanism introduced; the ROOT remains the dispatched/persisted identity.
cargo check/clippy -- -D warnings/fmt -- --check (all -p ff-desktop) are clean.
verification: Pipe each command through the pwsh7 wrapper to tools\logs\<name>.log and READ the log (one command per call; no ';' chaining).
cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings -- no warnings.
cargo test -p ff-desktop for each new test name AND the existing menu first-Tab focus test name -- confirm PASS in the log (scoped/bounded; do NOT run the full suite).
After the render.rs split, confirm both render.rs and render_layout.rs are under 400 non-test lines (read the files / count).
